notes.title: Early Access Release Date and Beta Playtest Results
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]This is a very special announcement. After the beta test and a lot of careful consideration, we believe [b]Northwind is ready for Early Access. [/b]We’re thrilled to let you know that [i]Northwind[/i] will launch in Early Access on [b]22nd September 2025! [/b]ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][b]Here is our Release Date Trailer![/b] [/p][previewyoutube="z6sdl4F51n4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]OMG! We'll be launching literally in just two weeks!!! As I’m writing this, we’re both nervous and excited at the same time. This is our debut title, and it’s been quite a journey. We first started developing [i]Northwind[/i] back in 2019 as just ideas, then began prototyping in 2020. That’s 5 years ago! Our team has worked on games before as employees for other companies, but this is the first one that’s fully ours! [b]Our vision of the game!
[/b][/p][p]At the beginning, we had no idea what the game would become. But you, our players, shaped it with us. Some of you joined us during alpha, some came for the demo, some returned for the beta and many of you are discovering [i]Northwind[/i] for the very first time. Whether you’ve been with us from the start or just found us today—[b]thank you so much for playing. [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Your feedback, your playtime, your support… all of it made [i]Northwind[/i] what it is today. And even now, right up until launch day, we’re polishing the game as much as possible.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re truly humbled and excited to have our launch date revealed during the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621-South-East-Asia-Game-Aesthetic/sale/thehungryghostfestival2025"]Hungry Ghost Festival![/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/2017a8240b1380fecd8b45c77638d813751c2ac1.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]The BETA Results[/b][/h3][p]We’d like to share some numbers from the beta test (no graphs this time, just a summary):[/p][list][*][p][b]150+ players[/b] participated in the beta.[/p][/*][*][p][b]50% new players, 50% veterans.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]1000+ runs[/b] were played.[/p][/*][*][p]Average playtime per person: around [b]7 hours across the week[/b], with 2–4 hours played daily.[/p][/*][*][p]About [b]30% of players won[/b] the game (defeated the final boss).[/p][/*][/list][p]We honestly didn’t expect these numbers! Thank you! it fills our team with joy and drives us to give everything we have for this final push before launch.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Fixes & Updates[/b][/h3][p]Here’s what we learned and what’s changing:[/p][list][*][p][b]Pyrotech unlocks:[/b] Only ~50% of players got to play Pyrotech. We wanted closer to 70%, so we’ve made her unlock condition easier. We also fixed several of her cards that were too difficult to use or not generating enough value.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss encounters:[/b] Fewer than 20% of players fought bosses beyond Wolf boss - Frostfangs. Some met the Warlord, but that was still too low. We’ve adjusted boss unlock conditions so players can encounter more bosses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hazard system:[/b] It didn’t feel impactful enough and came across as grindy. We'll make each Hazard more impactful to climb.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Card removal service:[/b] Prices will be more expensive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item pricing:[/b] Adjusted, since some items were clearly stronger than others.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Event UX: [/b] We found out that many players unintentionally skipped rewards. You’ll now be able to revisit the event page and make clearer choices than before.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Compendium:[/b] Now accessible at the [b]top-right corner of the screen[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]…and many more![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Final Words[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1476400/Northwind/"][/dynamiclink][i]Northwind[/i] has gone through... honestly.. I’ve lost count, maybe 5 playtest now? xD
Each one taught us so much about how to make the game better, thanks to you. The game wouldn’t be nearly as fun or as refined without your feedback and playtime.[/p][p]Now, we believe we’re ready to take the next step into [b]Early Access.[/b] The grind will still be there!! That’s what Early Access is for. We want to add so much more to the game, and we hope you’ll continue this journey with us, as we refine [i]Northwind[/i] together.[/p][p][b]– The Northwind Team, Barking Kitten Interactive[/b][/p]

notes.title: Update: The Tavern
notes.notes:
[p]
Hello everyone!

Apologies for not updating for a while ːsteamfacepalmːbut here we are, and we're super excited to share what's coming! [/p][list][*][p] The Tavern & New UI Update[/p][/*][*][p] Additionally, Localization will be moved to the Beta version[/p][/*][*][p] And lastly, our QA team is now onboard for final polishing![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🍖 The Tavern with Food Update![/h2][p][i]Remember this house right here? [/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/8c08e9de289cb406d43fa5d618554c1ce7af92ff.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We’d love to introduce you to our granny at the Tavern![/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/b0ebba2e5971a8622fe20416da509caaa0dbde74.png"][/img][/p][p]Now, reaching the outpost no longer heals you to 100% by default. Instead granny will make you those meals! It’s your choice how much '[b]YOU WANT TO HEAL[/b]'. Each food item offers unique effects, some can be helpful but comes with a price. More variety of food can be unlocked through progression. [/p][p][/p][p]Here are some samples of the food. Mmm! We absolutely love the designs, and we hope you do too![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/6e5d44e3cce6dfc1a489a06a993ebf4eef5001c8.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We got.. Frostfangs Steak Set, Bingsu Bird Ice Shaved, Thai Crispy Pork with Basil, Onigiri, Viper Vodka, Undead Tequila — you name it![/i]ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p]Ps. We've received a lot of feedback about our UI feeling unpolished and in need of improvements. Thanks to your suggestions in the feedback surveys, we’ve made major changes!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/341a8e4535c60254ba801f084f8f04d4a4b5e3b6.png"][/img][i]Of course, the changes apply to the entire game. We hope you're excited to see Northwind looking better than ever. Once everything is complete, we'll share new screenshots and update our entire store page (again!).[/i]
[/p][h2]
🌍 Localization Update[/h2][p] Originally, we planned to include localization in the demo. However, we ran into several language-specific issues. Because of this, we’ve decided to shift our localization efforts to the Early Access version instead.  This means updated tools and language support will be available in the Beta build.

If you're interested in helping us with localization, please let us know!
Reach out to us in [url="https://discord.gg/rMEqbNhkha" style="button"]Discord[/url]  and  [url="https://forms.gle/JrSPXKz26xpC9uYE7" style="button"]Beta Test Registration[/url][/p][p][/p][h2] 🔧 QA [/h2][p]Our QA team is finally in! 🎉 They were originally scheduled to begin in late June, but we needed a bit more time to build internal debugging tools and improve their workflow.  Now that everything is ready, they’ll be helping us test while we continue developing. Once they give us the green light, we’ll be inviting you in![/p][p][/p][h2]Thanks so much for your patience.
We know it’s been a wait. ❤️ ːsteamsadː[/h2][p][/p][p]🚀 [b]We're So Close to Early Access![/b][/p][p]We’ve been pouring our hearts into [i]Northwind[/i], you know when the QA team get serious! You can feel that we are so close to launch! We're both incredibly excited and a little nervous xD We hope you look forwar to it! [b]Thank you so, so much for your continued support, we couldn’t do this without you all![/b][/p][p]
— The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾[/p]

notes.title: New Update: Turn-Based Carnival
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋

[b]We’re honored to announce that we’ve been selected for the Turnbased Carnival! 🎉
[/b]If you enjoy turn-based games, check out the other incredible games featured there!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Acram/sale/turn-basedcarnival2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ff217742c2101d96f1167d8433ac38d86b13ced9.png[/img]
[/url]
We’d also like to take this opportunity to update you on our progress and share some of the exciting features we’ve been working on. Here are some highlights:

[h2]Countdown Token Replaces Rampage ⏳[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/536e8d0360583eeebc9d2321170a1d36177f555c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Is that a new UI!?[/b][/h3]
Yes! We’ve implemented a cleaner, more intuitive UI to make combat easier to understand.
Look forward to a brand new tutorial!

As for Rampage: Many players were confused about when Rampage would trigger...
Was it immediate or on the next turn??? We’ve replaced Rampage with a Countdown token, which triggers the special move once it reaches 0. [i](Not the official icon design)[/i]

[h3][b]This new mechanic lets you strategize and manage countdowns!
[/b][/h3]Use certain cards, relics, and perks to alter or delay enemy special moves. Plan your moves carefully!
(Fun Fact: The card [b]Taming Technique[/b] was designed by one of our interns!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/d3140734a9b2d50d4d1c3c9897532366722c8084.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/b8b24e401cf430f77130a804ebb11a01b8bd7a6c.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded Blacksmith Section 🔨[/h2]
We’ve revamped the Blacksmith to make navigating Merge, Forge, and Fuse services easier for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/ce2c5f2fcccca7cb7718676550c23c7db8a01af6.png[/img]
This includes adding blueprints to craft certain cards, so players have more clarity and control when upgrading their decks. We hope this helps you optimize your strategy seamlessly.

[h2]Moo Deng  🐾[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/cbd17f692425301aac2881baa148c54bc9da6d67.png[/img]
The pygmy hippo will be part of the perks in the game! 🎉
(In case you haven’t heard of Moo Deng, she’s a global sensation—a pygmy hippo from Thailand!)

[h2]Localization Delay 🌐[/h2]
As we implement updates, especially the new Countdown token, we’ve decided to delay localization for some languages until these mechanics are finalized. We apologize for not reaching out to our volunteers at this time; we want to ensure the game is more stable before reconnecting with them/you.

These are just a few of the exciting changes coming your way, with much more to come.
Thank you so much for your patience and support! ːheart_eyes_yetiː

The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾

notes.title: Game Devs of Color Expo x Next Update Coming in 2025!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋

Good news! We’ve been selected as a Game Devs of Color Expo Participant! 🎉
We’re incredibly humbled to be part of this event and to be featured! 🌟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/5582e0e86627183096825099025bdc9aaea9d46c.png[/img]
[h3]Unfortunately, our new demo won’t be available at the event. 😔
[/h3]Due to the many changes made in the game and several areas where we felt the need to put in extra effort, we believe it’s best to continue working hard and polishing the game before delivering it to you. 🛠️

[h3]Players, you mean so much to us! 💙
[/h3]We believe you deserve a more complete and refined version of the demo, especially after all the amazing feedback we’ve received. 🙏 The game is currently undergoing significant changes, including a tutorial revamp, addressing localization issues, and improving the UX/UI. 📝
With that, we will take our time to truly polish the game.

[b][h3]- The next update will be in 2025.
- The game’s Early Access launch is to be determined in 2025.[/h3][/b]
[b]Thank you so much for all your support, and we deeply apologize for taking so much time to polish the game. You deserve the best version of our game, and we are working our hardest to deliver it.
The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾[/b]

notes.title: Update our Progress - New Demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋

We want to provide an update on the progress we are making with our game.
We're working diligently on both the Early Access version and the Demo version, but it might take a little more time than we initially anticipated. All our resources are focused on game development and we aim to provide an update by the end of this month or in October. 📅

[h2]Here are some of the progress highlights:[/h2]

[h3]- Speed Options ⚡[/h3]
You can now choose a very fast gameplay speed, which has been implemented in the game.
[i][b][Will be Available in the Demo][/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/152d2795d0bbf98a4c96aae9efa14244e8a70bba.png[/img]

[h3]- Hazard Level ⚠️[/h3]
We'll unlock a few hazard levels for players looking for more competitiveness in the game. You'll need to defeat the boss to raise your hazard level. Hazard levels are separate for each mercenary.
[i][b][Will be Available in the Demo but with limited Content][/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/1f7c9f48970709c532ea2b906a778c3767b897d7.png[/img]

[h3]- New Town Progression System (TP) 🏘️[/h3]
We’ve added more features to the town progression system and fix UX Design, but we don’t want to spoil the details yet. However, we can say that it’s no longer the same as before.
[i][b][Will be Available in the Demo with limited Content][/b][/i]

[h3]- Visual Feedback Changes[/h3]
We've made a lot of visual feedback changes in the game. We don’t have pictures to share yet since it's not final, but it won’t be the same user experience you’ve seen in some parts of the game.
[i][b][Most should be available in the Demo][/b][/i]

[h3]- Content[/h3]
We've completed 80-90% of the content for the Early Access version. We are currently going through playtesting, balancing, and quality assurance. 🛠️ This means the Pyrotech is now complete, including all the additional events, relics, and perks in the game. 🎉
[i][b][Only the Duelist will be available in the Demo, but we'll definitely have some internal playtest for our Pyrotech][/b][/i]

[h3]- Localization 🌐[/h3]
Some parts of the visuals are still being implemented, which could affect localization. We’re waiting for everything to be finalized before starting the localization process. For those who have registered to help with translation, please stay tuned—we want to minimize changes before you jump in and assist us. However, we've been experimenting a lot with our local language, Thai.
[i][b][English and Thai should be available in the Demo.][/b][/i]

[h2]Intern[/h2]
Lastly, we are thrilled to announce that Vulpixon732, one of our active community members, has joined us as an intern! 🎉 We are more than happy to welcome him. He has shown great passion for helping Northwind from a game design perspective. 🎮 It's amazing to have this opportunity to welcome a student who loves deckbuilders and wants to be a part of Northwind. He’ll mainly be helping out with our game designers and doing a lot of playtesting. 🕹️

[h2]That's it for now! Thank you for your support. ❤️[/h2]
We promise you won't be disappointed with the changes in the demo. We are super excited to polish it up and let you all try the game. I apologize for not being able to set a specific date, but we assure you it’s going to be much better than any version you’ve played! 🚀
The Northwind Team at Barking Kitten Interactive 🐾

notes.title: Devlog#11 Happy New Year and Update January Milestone.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Happy New Year, guys; I hope you have a great time! ːsteamhappyː
As for the update, we want to share more about our milestones and what we will do this January.

[h3]This month, we are working on our Alpha Build.[/h3]
The game is solid, but it's still tough for new players to figure out how to play it. So we are trying to polish the UX and Control as much as possible.

[h3]Details about the Alpha build Phase 1.[/h3]
- The game covers the whole gameplay loop.
- A lot of art will still be a mock-up, and there will be no or little visual effects. 
- Alpha registration will be available this January.
- Steam keys are expected to be delivered in February. (We don't want to drag this out any longer ːcrying_yetiː )

We are torn between the Alpha build that looks good // or // has a complete core game loop.
We decide to go with a complete core loop. 

[b]Addition note:
1. If possible, we want to interview you after you play our Alpha test.
2. If you can't handle poor graphics, please wait for the Alpha Phase 2 or the Demo[/b]

For any further official announcements, we'll update you here.
Thank you for reading and support, have a wonderful week! ːsteamthumbsupː

[h3]Spoil:[/h3]
2nd Character is in development (Not Available in the Alpha Test.)

notes.title: Devlog #5 - Reschedule and Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We think our game trailer, playtest build, and Early access launch date will be later than expected. ːcrying_yetiː

[h2]Reschedule[/h2]
We will be honest with you! We planned to have our Trailer and playtest build this February.
However, it seems like it would be around [b]April - June[/b] instead.
As for our Early Access launch date, we think it might be around [b]Q4 2022 - Q1 2023[/b] ːsteamfacepalmː

[h2]UX/UI[/h2]
Sharing one of our struggles the UX/UI...
Well, there's a lot of work we need to put in here.
(This is definitely not the final version.) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/69adf68bba546fd3af2e0cbf40474c375f571ff7.png[/img]
Our card game doesn't play like Slay the Spire.
Cards generate attack points, attack points are accumulated and will be resolved when you press End Turn.

[h3]For example[/h3]
You play 5 cards, the total attack points you get is 39.
Monster defend at 22. You'll deal 17 damage points to the monster.
[u][i]Don't worry about calculating the outcome, the game prediction system will do the work for you.[/i][/u]

We also have a lot of keywords to play with this system. ːsteamboredː
We can't release the playtest build and the game trailer until we polish this up, we need to make sure you can quickly grasp the gameplay and enjoy the game.

[h2]Town Design[/h2]
We want/plan to add our town feature to this playtest build, but we'll update you again if it's ready. ːlaughing_yetiː
For the time being, here's the concept art for our town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41370544/68f455993bc641958ee60ca8b060aad4e5fb56c5.png[/img]

[h2]Original sound track![/h2]
Yep, we start working on our OST as well as our game sound effect in February. ːsteamhappyː
We won't share it here, but we want to let you know we have it done and you'll hear it in our trailer!

[h3]We'll be returning on [url=https://twitter.com/Northwindgame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/Northwindgame/]Facebook[/url] this month![/h3]
We've been working on one of the most difficult aspects of game production for the past few months, so we are ready to come back with some updates on our social media! We appreciate all of the support and patience you've shown us so far. We will give the best shot in our playtest build and the gameplay trailer. ːhappy_yetiː ːheart_eyes_yetiː
